WITH station_data AS (
    SELECT 
        observstation,
        ROUND((atmostransparency * 100) / (humidityrate + windspeedms), 4) as aoiscore,
        lunarstage,
        lunardistdeg,
        solarstatus,
        CASE 
            WHEN (atmostransparency * 100) / (humidityrate + windspeedms) > 0.85
                AND lunarstage IN ('New', 'First Quarter')
                AND lunardistdeg > 45
                AND solarstatus IN ('Low', 'Moderate')
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END as meets_oow
    FROM observatories
)
SELECT 
    meets_oow,
    COUNT(*) as station_count,
    ROUND(AVG(aoiscore), 4) as avg_aoi,
    json_agg(
        json_build_object(
            'station_name', observstation,
            'aoi_value', aoiscore,
            'lunar_factors', json_build_object(
                'lunar_stage', lunarstage,
                'lunar_distance', lunardistdeg
            ),
            'solar_condition', solarstatus
        )
    ) as environmental_factors
FROM station_data
GROUP BY meets_oow
ORDER BY meets_oow;
